svg.title: CubeRoot · Cubetown — 魔方游乐城
svg.desc: Original, densely illustrated isometric cubing city in cream, terracotta, jade and ochre. A cube workshop, Square-1 observatory, Pyraminx greenhouse, Megaminx water tower, ferris wheel, tram, loading crane, cubing tables, cafe and parks. Small CubeRoot mark at the bottom right. Actual puzzles exported from CubeRoot SIM. Native vector art without images, external fonts or filters.
svg.metadata: CubeRoot Cubetown 02. Original art composition. 2:1 review artwork for a desk/cubing mat. Puzzle contours: CubeRoot puzzle-render-core schematic exporter. Architecture, scene and characters: native SVG. Physical dimensions, bleed and print color proof must be set for the chosen manufacturer.
